answer_1.quote: Recently, research on QA systems has reached the stage of generating free-form answers, called GenQA

answer_2.quote: we propose a new metric called KPQAmetric for evaluating GenQA systems

answer_4.quote: We hire workers from the Amazon Mechanical Turk (MTurk) to rate the correctness of the generated answers
answer_4.guideline: We ask the workers to annotate correctness using a 5-point Likert scale, where 1 means completely wrong, and 5 means completely correct
